# Vanguard University

> Vanguard University is a faith-based institution in Orange County dedicated to Christian education, community care, and developing leaders rooted in service.

Vanguard University is Orange County's first four-year college with a 100-year history, affiliated with the Assemblies of God and accredited by WASC. The university emphasizes Christian values, diversity and inclusion through its Community Care initiative, and maintains a strong commitment to teacher education through its School of Education.
